why: The statement is uniform finiteness over all exponent triples; no event reaches it. Results settling one signature or an infinite family of signatures (Zhou's tail and exception-set claims, Mihailescu's (p,p,q), Chocian's (3,5,7)) are restrictions, so case. Sikora's bounded search is instances. Pacetti-Villagra and Sahoo are conditional on unproven hypotheses (large-image conjecture, S-unit condition), so none; Darmon-Granville (finiteness per fixed triple) is a weaker form, so variant; the FLT formalisation verifies a known result, so none. Zhou and Mihailescu are kept as doubtful rather than not_credible: the IUT dependency and the coprimality/date issues are real but no specific error in their arguments is identified, and Mihailescu is established in the field. Vega has the stacked F10 signals. For Chocian, Codex is credited with 'developing ... mathematical arguments', which is mathematics in the result, so assisted; Claude's role was auditing (none) and ChatGPT's quote is too vague to credit.
doubts: Chocian's Section 8 was read through a summarised fetch, not verbatim; the assisted call rests on that quote. Zhou and Vega credibility calls (doubtful vs not_credible) are close. Pre-snapshot classical results are marked digested on their universal acceptance, though the record did not open the primary papers. Rafik's content is unknown.
